cache_origin: Exact root E_stage producer job and source/seed/plan/data/donor cache export required; final model/probability output closure binds cache authority/payload.
capacity_cost: Added full private local message blocks/readout and raw-feature accesses are paid; no speed/storage superiority claim. Native4 cost holding all4 models is a storage upper bound relative to serial fit source. Complete1100 convergence and all selection costs remain outside one-epoch cost probes.
common_controls: One exact cached donor H/z shared between E_stage/E_joint/E_own. Same shapes/input support/rawfeatures/private draw/100 updates each. E_joint applies per-route gradient before simultaneous path changes; no accidental fourfold pooled-term overweighting.
cost_gate: Conservative root-owned finite caps account for complete schedules, enabled diagnostic VJPs, native serving, CPU transfer, snapshots, serialization and rematerialization. Actual full epoch costs logged during science; optional14-case probes are not prerequisites.
initial_inclusion: Full private graph units finite, dense residual output exactlyzero. In real arithmetic initial bank equals donor. Runtime requires literal equality to the same captured donor probabilities; this avoids claiming a second nondeterministic GAT forward is exact. Native source/weights/mode provenance and same-call hook identity remain mandatory.
native_selected_replay_metadata_limit: Native v3 SELECTED_REPLAY source_and_checkpoint_hashes_verified=True is not pre-load expected-checkpoint certification. Donor custody uses root-bound NATIVE_FREEZE and rehashed selected/end files. Recorded numerical variation does not trigger reselection.
risk_to_qualify: No model work run by this agent. Ordinary integrated finite-update smoke is part of scheduled training. Original-tolerance private/manual-VJP and full local/global single checkpoint/ordinary reference implementations are retained unchanged as optional later TRAIN-only diagnostics. A diagnostic failure remains failure.
source_v3_scope: run.py changes add ordinary finite checks and evidence, record replay variation, and require native-v3 donor source/policy. common.py changes engineering admission only. method/model/loss/optimizer/seed/schedule/selector/capacity code stays byte-identical to v2.
strong_single: All4 full native message paths plus nonlinear joint decoder and live complete backbone; optimizer history for donor retained. No head-only or one-path single. No hidden-cache for trainable base. Rematerialized base/path messages count as real work.
teacher_free: No separate teacher fit/distillation targets: ground-truth TRAIN labels and live served probability residual; a competent own learned donor supplies initialization/features. Staged boosting is known (GrowNet,BoostResNet,AdaGCN,BGNN/B3F-GNN) and joint fitting may beat permanent freezing.
validation: Only donor source selectors use native VALID during acquisition. Residual endpoint states saved before first fixed-endpoint VALID analysis. No TEST payload or label, stage selection, recipe alternatives or rescue grid.
